messages:
Harper (Design): Quick copy check on the bulk "delete sessions" flow. Current modal title is `Delete sessions` and body says: `This action cannot be undone.` Users are confused about scope (all sessions vs selected) and whether data is retained elsewhere.
Liam (PM): We had one support ticket where customer thought this only affected the UI, not stored logs. Need to be explicit about what is deleted and recovery options.
Zoe (Copy): Draft body: "Delete the selected sessions and their associated session data (logs, cached KV). This cannot be undone." Secondary line: "You can export session logs before deleting." CTA: "Delete sessions" (danger)
Chen (Eng): Backend note: we delete session metadata and cached state, but historical logs retained in long-term storage for up to 30 days unless Privacy mode on. Suggest we add a parenthetical: `(historic logs retained up to 30 days)` only if accurate.
Rowan (A11y): From an a11y POV, avoid relying on visual emphasis alone for the irreversible bit. Also screen readers should get more context: add `aria-describedby` linking to the explanation and make the primary CTA `Delete sessions, cannot be undone`? That might be verbose.
Harper (Design): Visually we can include a small info line under the title with the short scope: `Deleting the selected X sessions.` Then body explains what data is removed and the export option. Keep the CTA short.
Zoe (Copy): Revised concise copy bundle:
- Title: "Delete selected sessions"
- Short scope line: "Deletes selected sessions and related session data."
- Body: "This removes session metadata and cached state. Historical logs are retained up to 30 days unless Privacy mode is enabled. Export any logs you need before deleting."
- Primary CTA: "Delete sessions" (danger)
- Secondary CTA: "Export logs"
Rowan (A11y): For SRs add `aria-label` on primary CTA: `Delete selected sessions, irreversible` and ensure the short scope line is included in `aria-describedby` for the dialog. Also keyboard focus should land on `Export logs` by default to reduce accidental destructive clicks.
Liam (PM): Good call on focus — defaulting to the safer action is nice. Agree with the copy.
Chen (Eng): Implementation plan: change modal template to accept `scope_line` and `export_link`. We can set focus on `Export logs` via the dialog component. Backend will confirm the 30-day retention note; if it's conditional we should phrase: "Typically retained up to 30 days."
Zoe (Copy): Swap line to: "Historical logs are typically retained up to 30 days unless Privacy mode is enabled." Slightly softer.
Harper (Design): Finalize then: title, scope line, body with softer retention copy, CTAs, and a11y notes. I'll update Figma and annotate the dialog component for focus order.
